title: frameproj
description: Layered editable Frame project. SOURCE OF TRUTH for FrameProject.swift (regenerate with: Renderer.py --generate-swift Sources/FrameCore/FrameProject.swift). Each layer is independently replaceable: open -> edit one layer -> re-render without touching other layers.

frameproj.description: Schema version. Readers must accept version 1 and preserve unknown fields for forward compatibility.

canvas.description: Optional output dimensions. Foreground fits inside this canvas with its aspect ratio preserved.

screenshot.description: Layer 1: raw input pixels. Replace path to swap content; other layers untouched.

path.description: Absolute path to the source screenshot file.

sha256.description: Optional integrity hash (hex). Renderer errors on mismatch when present.

frame.description: Layer 2: device bezel applied via frames CLI. Re-run frames to refresh output; backdrop/adjust untouched.

device.description: Exact frames device name, e.g. MacBook Pro PROLED 16.

color.description: Frame color name, e.g. Space Black.

output.description: Cached framed PNG (RGBA). When absent or missing, the renderer runs frames to regenerate the foreground.

backdrop.description: Layer 3: studio backdrop + foreground geometry. Swap path/color or retune without re-framing.

path.description: Photo backdrop file. Cover-resized to the framed canvas.

color.description: Solid backdrop color (#RRGGBB). Used when path is absent.

blur.description: GaussianBlur radius applied to the backdrop.

grain.description: Gaussian grain sigma added to the backdrop.

scale.description: Foreground scale relative to framed size (0.70 reproduces the desert reference).

offset.description: Foreground offset [dx, dy] in px added to the centered position.

adjust.description: Layer 4: final color adjustments applied to the composite.

animation.description: Layer 5: motion metadata for video export. Ignored by the still renderer; always preserved.

export.description: Video export path for frames video / skill animation.
